There is currently no federal law stopping a registered sex offender from becoming a parent through surrogacy. 

We introduced the Protecting Children in Surrogacy Act to close the loophole. This bill would ban registered sex offenders from obtaining children through surrogacy arrangements. The legislation imposes criminal penalties of up to 10 years in federal prison for violations.

Children are not commodities, and surrogacy will not be weaponized by predators.

posts.text:
Right now, the EPA only requires two generations of testing before approving a pesticide's safety. Not nearly enough data to catch long-term harm.

We introduced the SOUND Pesticide Research Act to double the standard to four generations of testing. The bill also directs the EPA to audit existing pesticide safety determinations within 180 days and report back to Congress within two years.

Prove it is safe, or keep it off the market. Our health is not optional.

Make America Healthy Again.
